messages:
lee_k: Quick heads-up: scheduling a night window for az3 on Tue 04/12 01:30 UTC. Purpose: NIC driver soft-reload + GPU node graceful reboot across 12 nodes in pool-saturn. Expected impact: staggered capacity churn, target <1% error.

priya_m: Noted. What's the plan for draining? full drain or evict-batch first?

lee_k: We'll cordon then evict user pods with `kubectl drain` w/ 2m grace. Sequence: 3 nodes concurrently (cohort size=3), then wait 10m for KV cache reseed and p95 checks. Repeat x4.

`kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=5m`

tom_r: Can we reduce batch sizes in-flight to lower memory while cohorts are rebuilding? Suggest target_batch 24 -> 12 for 40 minutes.

nina_g: +1. Also plan to run `kv_seed` after each cohort uncordon. I'll add the command to the checklist.

lee_k: kv seed command: `./infra/kv_seed --pool pool-saturn --workers 3 --duration 15m`

priya_m: Heads up — one of the nodes (saturn-az3-gpu-112) has active long-running eval pods. We should migrate/evict them earlier or notify the tenant.

lee_k: Good catch. We'll attempt graceful pod migration 1h before window. If pods refuse to move, we'll exclude that node and pick a spare.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: PM-2026-1902. Assigned runbook and oncall -> oncall_emma for 04/12 01:30 UTC. Canary rule added.

oncall_emma: I'm on-call then. Please add exact node list and the rollback trigger thresholds.

lee_k: Rollback triggers: error-rate +1% sustained for 3 mins OR p95 increase >300ms for 2 mins OR canary fail. Canary script: `tests/canary_lowqps.sh` run after first cohort uncordon.

tom_r: Cost note: if we need to route traffic to eu-central for cushion, egress adds ~0.07 TB for 1h at our qps -> approx $5. Warmbackfill in-region (reserve 6 spare GPUs) estimated 6 GPU-hours -> ~$18. Prefer warmbackfill if possible.

priya_m: Agreed warmbackfill is cheaper than cross-region egress. We'll prestart 6 warm nodes in az3-us-east fallback pool if needed.

nina_g: I'll add the batch-override and warmbackfill steps to the rollback plan. Also will monitor node CPU during kv seed — it spikes short-lived CPU.

lee_k: Ops checklist highlights: full node list (saturn-az3-gpu-101..112), drain order (101-103-105-107 etc staggered), kv seed after each cohort, batch-size override, canary run, rollback thresholds. Post-checks: run smoke `scripts/smoke_endpoints.sh` and telemetry dashboard snapshot.

oncall_emma: I'll perform canary and post results. If anything flaky, we abort and uncordon cohort.

infra-bot: Preflight checks scheduled: 04/11 23:30 UTC (1h before) -> load tests, node health, disk usage, and long-job scan. Reminder will ping channel.

tom_r: Budget approval: maintenance budget covers warmbackfill + 1.5h labor. Estimated cost ~ $25 total. Finance ok'd.

priya_m: CS outreach: I'll email 2 enterprise customers with ETA and expected behavior. Template ready.

lee_k: Thanks. Final checklist will be posted 30m prior with exact kubectl commands and cohort start times. React with :thumbsup: if you can attend.

lee_k: :thumbsup:

priya_m: :thumbsup:

tom_r: :thumbsup:

nina_g: :thumbsup:

oncall_emma: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: PM-2026-1902 status: scheduled -> Tue 04/12 01:30 UTC.
